name: Headline CPI (YoY)
description: Year-on-year change in the consumer price index across all goods and services tracked by the NBS basket. The headline measure of inflation.

name: Food CPI (YoY)
description: Year-on-year change in food prices. Tracks the household food basket — typically the most-watched component for everyday Nigerians.

name: Monetary Policy Rate
description: The CBN's benchmark interest rate. Set by the Monetary Policy Committee at its bi-monthly meetings.

name: Naira / USD (NAFEM)
description: Official Naira-Dollar exchange rate at the Nigerian Autonomous Foreign Exchange Market (NAFEM).

name: Gross External Reserves
description: Total foreign exchange holdings of the CBN. A buffer against external shocks and a key driver of FX defence.

name: Crude Oil Production
description: Average daily crude oil production excluding condensate, in million barrels per day. Aggregated by NUPRC across all producing terminals.

name: NGX All-Share Index
description: Broad measure of the Nigerian equities market, weighted by market capitalisation across all listed equities on the Main Board.

name: Monthly FAAC Allocation
description: Federal revenue shared each month between federal, state and local government tiers through the Federation Account Allocation Committee.

name: Total Public Debt Stock
description: Combined federal and state external plus domestic debt stock. Published quarterly in the DMO's debt bulletin.

name: Debt Service to Revenue
description: Share of federal government revenue spent on servicing debt. The single most-watched sustainability metric for Nigeria's public finances.

name: Real GDP Growth
description: Year-on-year real (inflation-adjusted) growth in Gross Domestic Product, published quarterly by the NBS.

name: Unemployment Rate
description: Share of the labour force without paid work and actively seeking it, per the NBS Nigeria Labour Force Survey methodology.
